profile.headline: Building all kinds of things @ Substrate AI
profile.summary:
I love what I do.

I am a software engineer with a background in consulting and the life sciences. I leverage my diverse educational and work experiences to solve complex problems with unconventional solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Standing up AI agents to help revenue cycle management less crappy.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building the platform behind WW Clinic.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Building things on the Database Sources team.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built and worked on Workflow Engines before they were cool.
- Enable developers and non-developers to build robust and scalable communications applications with Studio - Twilio’s low-code/no-code platform.
- I work on increasing scalability and resiliency of our systems to maintain high availability.

Former Hatch Apprentice (inaugural cohort)
- Bootstrapped and built an open-source fullstack phone-banking system to increase voter participation

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Lead academic enrichment classes and one-on-one instruction in the natural sciences and standardized test preparation.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description: Utilizing biomedical, genetics, and molecular biology techniques to determine the factors that causes atherogenic dyslipidemia.

positions.title: Scholarship Recipient
positions.description: The Incentive Awards Program provides educational and financial access to high-achieving students who face socio-economic barriers from underserved communities throughout California. We commit to cultivate future leaders through civic engagement and provide comprehensive student-centered support services to succeed at UC Berkeley and beyond.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Molecular and Cell Biology - Cell Development Emphasis

volunteerExperiences.description:
Founded, managed, and served as a mentor for the UC Berkeley branch of a non-profit organization which empowers low-income, under-served high school seniors throughout the state of California. 

As an organization, we assists our students in the college and scholarships application process. Our goal is to help these students attend college as well as succeed there.
